name: Dropped Head Syndrome
definition: Marked weakness of neck extensor muscles causing inability to maintain the head in an upright position, arising from neuromuscular, parkinsonian, inflammatory or structural causes.

typical: Possible dysphagia or gait issues depending on cause

investigations.principle: Cause-directed labs, EMG and cervical/brain imaging are selected according to phenotype.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Treatment depends entirely on the underlying cause; avoid assuming a simple mechanical neck disorder.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva/Bala-kshaya phenotype may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Marked weakness of neck extensor muscles causing inability to maintain the head in an upright position, arising from neuromuscular, parkinsonian, inflammatory or structural causes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
